decision_model.phase_A_reproduced: mean log2 step-speedup >= log2(1.15) and lower endpoint of the paired seven-seed 95% Student interval > 0
decision_model.phase_B_survives: lower endpoint of the paired seven-seed 95% Student interval for retuned mu=.75 minus retuned mu=0 log2 step-speedup > log2(1.05)
decision_model.vanishes_semantics: failure of the preregistered survival test after Phase A reproduction; not an equivalence claim unless the separately reported CI lies inside the equivalence band

scope: decision-rule power under the published fixed-recipe alternative and either a tuned null or tuned survival alternative; not evidence that SNOO reproduces

source.primary_source: Kallusky et al., SNOO: Step-K Nesterov Outer Optimizer, arXiv:2510.15830v1
